next.reason: 1985: 'The NEXT PAGE phrase specifies that the report group is to be presented beginning on the indicated line number on a new page' (body groups and report footing only, per its SR7; the body-group table rule 3c presents the first body group of the report on the current page). 2023 keeps it: §2023:13.18.35.4 GR4 'If the first LINE clause has a NEXT PAGE phrase, no page fit test takes place and the page fit is declared unsuccessful' (so a page advance precedes every body group but the chronologically first since INITIATE, which 1985 3c also leaves on the current page); §2023:13.18.35.4 GR5 puts the first line at integer-1 and 'If in addition the NEXT PAGE phrase is present and the report group is a report footing, the first line is printed beginning on a new page'; §2023:13.18.37.4 GR4 a)2 keeps 1985 rule 3c's handling after an absolute NEXT GROUP ('a page advance takes place, the save location is moved to LINE-COUNTER'). Same presentation for every conforming 1985 program.
